about_the_game:
This is the original soundtrack of Carrotour! Made by lì tŕ, it contains 9 tracks (2 of which are short jingles). Here's the track list:

1. Carrotour (main theme)

2. Yummy Carrots (Leappa's theme)

3. An Open Tour (puzzle level theme)

4. There's No Detour (boss fight impending theme)

5. Camel Thorns (Humel's theme)

6. Elephant Stampede (Alphil's theme)

7. Horse Schemes (Marquus's theme)

8. Think Ahead (level failed jingle)

9. A Leaper's Victory (level completed jingle)
